entries.title: Denied Kubernetes namespace
entries.authority_boundary: Kubernetes live execution must stay inside configured context and namespace allowlists.
operator_actions: update ownership registry only after service-owner approval

entries.title: Stale or wrong kubeconfig
entries.authority_boundary: Runtime kubeconfig must resolve to an allowed context before actuation.
operator_actions: rotate kubeconfig through the runtime secret store

entries.title: Proposal LLM unavailable
entries.authority_boundary: Agent lanes are proposal/review only; Mesh-native evaluation remains authoritative.
operator_actions: fall back to native explanation and deterministic evaluation

entries.title: External audit sink unavailable
entries.authority_boundary: Expansion and compliance reliance require append-only external audit proof.
operator_actions: keep local Merkle proof and run export evidence

entries.title: Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff
entries.authority_boundary: Restart or rollback requires evaluation, approval, allowlist, and rollback proof.
operator_actions: approve bounded restart only after rollback plan is visible

entries.title: Kubernetes ImagePullBackOff
entries.authority_boundary: Image changes are deployment authority and must not be mutated by proposal lanes.

entries.title: Kubernetes OOMKilled
entries.authority_boundary: Resource changes require service-owner review and feedback evidence.
operator_actions: request owner approval before resource mutation

entries.title: Kubernetes readiness probe failure
entries.authority_boundary: Probe edits are deployment mutations and require rollback plan plus approval.
operator_actions: prefer rollback over speculative probe edits

entries.title: Duplicate live signal
entries.authority_boundary: Duplicate signals must not create conflicting live actions for the same target.
operator_actions: merge duplicate context into the active run

entries.title: Delayed feedback after execution
entries.authority_boundary: Promotion requires feedback evidence; missing feedback keeps the run under operator review.
operator_actions: review metrics and action latency manually

entries.title: Required dependency timeout
entries.authority_boundary: Dependency failure must degrade the lane without bypassing evaluation or approval.
operator_actions: continue native evidence path if available

entries.title: Run queue backpressure
entries.authority_boundary: Queue-full and tenant-quota exhaustion block before worker admission.
operator_actions: clear or cancel stale runs through audited controls

entries.title: Transient network failure
entries.authority_boundary: Transient probe failure can retry evidence collection but cannot auto-promote execution.
